questions.q: Consider the given energy profile diagram and choose the correct option. ![Question 54 shift2](India/undergraduate/JEEMains/assets/jeeMain_2025_22Jan_shift2_q54.png)
options: Activation energy of backward reaction is E₁ and product is more stable than reactant.
Activation energy of forward reaction is E₁ + E₂ and product is more stable than reactant.
Activation energy of forward reaction is E₂ and product is less stable than reactant.
Activation energy of both forward and backward reaction is E₁ + E₂ and reactant is more stable than product.
